bioconductor.name: dStruct
bioconductor.summary: Identifying differentially reactive regions from RNA structurome profiling data
bioconductor.description: dStruct identifies differentially reactive regions from RNA structurome profiling data. dStruct is compatible with a broad range of structurome profiling technologies, e.g., SHAPE-MaP, DMS-MaPseq, Structure-Seq, SHAPE-Seq, etc. See Choudhary et al., Genome Biology, 2019 for the underlying method.
bioconductor.author: Krishna Choudhary [aut, cre] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7966-1527>), Sharon Aviran [aut] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1872-9820>)
